description: Mirage IIIEBR FAB 4931 installed on a pedestal in Praça Orungan on 20 Aug 2015 after serving 1972-2005 with the 1º GDA at Anápolis; de-corroded and repainted by the FAB in May-June 2020. Photographed in place 2 Nov 2025 (airplane-pictures.net).
